title: The record's context field is redacted at record construction, not at emission
asA: operator concerned about PII in error records
iWant: the context field on the record to be redacted at construction time by the logging companion's redaction categories
soThat: the record itself never carries un-redacted PII even if the emitter fails to redact

acceptanceCriteria.description: createErrorRecord({..., context: {email: 'x@y', ip: '1.2.3.4'}}) with pii.email in the redaction category set returns a record whose context.email equals [REDACTED:pii.email]; the caller's original context object is not mutated.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a call to the factory with a context object carrying a pii.email field
acceptanceCriteria.then: the returned record's context.email equals [REDACTED:pii.email] and the caller's context object still holds the original value

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given `createErrorRecord({context: <value>})` called with a context value that is not a plain object (a string, a number, a Date, null), the factory refuses with a controlled error naming the invalid context type; no record is constructed and no partial context leaks. The check enumerates the non-object inputs and inspects the thrown error.
acceptanceCriteria.given: createErrorRecord called with a context that is not a plain object (string, number, Date, null)
acceptanceCriteria.then: it throws a controlled error naming the invalid context type; no record is constructed and no partial context is returned

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given `createErrorRecord({context: nested})` where `nested` carries redactable fields at depth (`user.email`, `payment.card.pan`, an array containing an object with an `ip`), the returned record has every redactable field replaced by `[REDACTED:<category>]` at every depth including array elements; sibling fields at each depth are untouched. The check builds a nested-and-array-mixed context and walks the returned record asserting the redaction shape.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a context carrying redactable fields at nested depths and inside arrays
acceptanceCriteria.then: every redactable field at every depth (including inside arrays) reads `[REDACTED:<category>]`; sibling fields at each depth remain unchanged and the caller's original context object is not mutated

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given `createErrorRecord({context: circular})` where the context object contains a cyclic reference, the factory returns a record whose context serialises safely (the cycle is broken with a controlled marker such as `[CIRCULAR]`) and the redaction pass still fires on the reachable fields; no stack overflow, no unbounded recursion.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a context object containing a circular reference
acceptanceCriteria.then: the returned record's context serialises without stack overflow, the cycle is broken with a controlled marker, and redaction still applies to the reachable fields
